title: Verb Selection Decision Tree
description: Interactive Mermaid decision tree for choosing between ADL verb, ADL verb + extension, or custom verb when instrumenting a new xAPI emit site.
creator: xAPI Course Project
subject: xAPI
Verb Vocabulary
ADL Registry

chapter_title: Verb Vocabulary Design and the ADL Verb Registry
learningObjectives: Walk a four-question decision tree to choose the right verb category for a new emit site.
Recognize when an extension is sufficient and a custom verb is unjustified.
Articulate the ongoing cost of adding a custom verb to a profile.

prerequisites: Familiarity with the xAPI verb concept
Awareness of the ADL verb registry

pedagogical.instructionalPattern: Click-to-reveal branch detail on a decision tree
pedagogical.learningObjective: Apply a structured decision process to choose between an ADL verb, a canonical verb plus extension, or a custom verb for any new emit site.
assessmentOpportunities: Trace a real emit site through the tree and justify the outcome
Identify a custom verb in a project profile that should have been an extension
Explain why the steward review step exists
